content.short: Duelist King is a blockchain NFT card game with tokenized cards, DAO mechanics, and randomization tools.
content.description: Duelist King is an online NFT card game platform designed around tokenized cards and blockchain-based participation. The project describes a stack that includes a DAO, oracle, and random-number generator, with card issuance, distribution, and proceeds intended to follow transparent community-oriented rules. Its broader pitch is to change how players play, earn, and participate in card games by anchoring those systems in on-chain mechanics. Duelist King fits Cardano as part of the Web3 gaming and collectible-card category.
